Planning a trip to Gaya Ji for Pind Daan? Many pilgrims have questions and concerns before visiting—how to reach the ashram or hotel from the railway station, what the room and food arrangements are like, where to arrange puja materials, and whether Gayawal Pandas demand unexpected extra money.
